name: Terrain
line: A Swiss-map sheet: generative contour lines drift slowly (and shift as you scroll) behind a map title block holding the headline and search; the four IARC groups become altitude bands on a mountain profile, risk sits on a map scale bar, and the explorers are framed map sheets with legends.
notes: The contours are generated from noise and show no data; the page says so ('Contours illustrative'). Canvas is drawn at device pixel ratio, pauses off-screen, and is drawn once with reduced motion; without JavaScript a CSS ring pattern stands in. Both families have Cyrillic and Greek; Chinese falls back to the system font.
